Foreclosure vs Short Sale Explained | Central Texas Homeowner Guide

Foreclosure and short sale are NOT the same — and the decision you make can impact your future for years.

The biggest mistake homeowners make? Waiting too long.

A short sale may give you more control and less long-term damage, but timing is everything. Once foreclosure progresses, your options can shrink fast.

If you're in Central Texas and not sure what to do next, we’ll walk you through your options privately and without pressure.
